title: Pairing decomposition at a prefix separator
statement: Let $y$ be a bit string, and let $r$ be the length of its initial run of ones. If $r$ is even, the bit of $y$ at index $r$ is $0$, and the bit at index $r+1$ is $1$, then $y$ is the pairing of the unary string of $r/2$ ones with the suffix of $y$ beginning at index $r+2$.
hypotheses_covered: the initial run length $r$ is even
